tweet.text:
TDD is a human discipline.  I don't expect agents to follow it.  I DO expect agents to write unit tests as carefully and comprehensively as a human would, and I ensure that by running coverage, crap, and mutation tests.  

The reason agents don't have to follow the tight human TDD loop is that they have better and bigger short term memories.
